Subject: Access intake & role mapping for Horizon Health workspace

Hi Marcus / Monica / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to kick off the tenant setup for Horizon Health's prod workspace. To make the initial provisioning smooth, can you confirm the information we should provide and the format? Attached is our internal intake spreadsheet (Horizon_Onboarding_MATP.xlsx) with a preliminary list of users.

High-level asks from our side:
- We need an admin user + 2 engineers seeded as org admins.
- A service account for nightly batch jobs (will hold API key).
- Guidance on KMS integration for secrets (we prefer AWS KMS in us-east-1).
- Expected timeline for invite + API key seeding and any required PO/contract step.

Preferred kickoff windows (PST): Tue 11/4 10:30-11:30 or Wed 11/5 14:00-15:00.

Attaching the intake spreadsheet for fields you typically require. Happy to adapt to your template.

Thanks,
Laura Jensen
Head of Platform Operations
Horizon Health

Attachment: Horizon_Onboarding_MATP.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46KB)

Subject: Re: Access intake & role mapping for Horizon Health workspace

Laura — thanks for the spreadsheet and the times. We can take the Wed 11/5 14:00 PST slot; I'll send a calendar invite after we align internally.

Minimum data we need to seed the workspace and API keys (I've attached a small template):
- Admins: full name + corporate email + mobile for MFA recovery
- Engineers: name + email + primary GitHub/SSO ID (if applicable)
- Service accounts: intended use, token lifetime, allowed IP ranges (if you want IP restrict)
- Billing contact + PO number (if you have an initial commit)

Action plan (we'll follow this during kickoff):
1) Create workspace "horizon-health-prod" in us-east region.
2) Seed two org-admin accounts and one service account (we'll generate a one-time API key for seeding; you can rotate it into KMS).
3) Send invites for invited users with role suggestions (Admin / Developer / Viewer).
4) Walk through KMS integration notes and provide an example policy for AWS KMS.

I've attached Org_Roles_Template.csv — please fill the columns marked REQUIRED and return before the kickoff where possible. If you're unable to, we'll walk through live and capture the values.

We'll also create a shared doc with the mutual action plan and deliverables.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Org_Roles_Template.csv (CSV, 2KB)
